jp: その体は目も眩むような黄金色の輝きを放つ。一儲けしようと欲張ってこのゴーレムを狙い、雇った傭兵ごとノシイカにされる商人が後を絶たない。
jp_grezzo: "その体は目も眩むような黄金色の輝きを放つ。一儲けしようと欲張ってこのゴーレムを狙い、雇った傭兵ごとノシイカにされる商人が後を絶たない。"
en: Its body radiates a dazzling golden glow. There is no end to the number of merchants who greedily target this golem in order to make a profit, and are beaten up by the mercenaries they have hired.
en_grezzo: "Its body radiates a dazzling golden glow. There is no end to the number of merchants who greedily target this golem in order to make a profit, and are beaten up by the mercenaries they have hired."
it: Il suo corpo manda un bagliore dorato che acceca. Non si contano i mercanti che, avidi di guadagno, puntano questo golem e finiscono spianati come stoccafissi insieme ai mercenari che hanno assoldato.

jp: ミスリル製のゴーレム。丈夫だが軽いというミスリルのイメージを吹き飛ばしてしまいそうなほどに、繰り出すその一撃は重い。なお、魔法は使えない模様。
jp_grezzo: "ミスリル製のゴーレム。丈夫だが軽いというミスリルのイメージを吹き飛ばしてしまいそうなほどに、繰り出すその一撃は重い。なお、魔法は使えない模様。"
en: Golem made of mithril. Its blows are so heavy that they seem to blow away the image of mithril as strong but light. It appears to be incapable of using magic.
en_grezzo: "Golem made of mithril. Its blows are so heavy that they seem to blow away the image of mithril as strong but light. It appears to be incapable of using magic."
it: Un golem fatto di mithril. Il colpo che sferra è talmente pesante da spazzare via l'idea che il mithril sia robusto ma leggero. La magia, a quanto pare, non sa usarla.

jp: イルヴァに存在しない物質で作られている。このゴーレムが空から降ってきたという目撃談があり、天空に別の世界が存在するのではないかと議論の的になっていたことも。
jp_grezzo: "イルヴァに存在しない物質で作られている。このゴーレムが空から降ってきたという目撃談があり、天空に別の世界が存在するのではないかと議論の的になっていたことも。"
en: It is made of a substance that does not exist in Irva. There have been eyewitness accounts of this golem falling from the sky, and it has even been debated whether another world exists in the sky.
en_grezzo: "It is made of a substance that does not exist in Irva. There have been eyewitness accounts of this golem falling from the sky, and it has even been debated whether another world exists in the sky."
it: È fatto di una sostanza che in Irva non esiste. C'è chi giura di aver visto questo golem cadere dal cielo, e la cosa ha fatto discutere se lassù non esista un altro mondo.

jp: 希少な鉱石を惜しげもなく使って作られた。長らくゴーレムの最上級種とされていたくらいなので、並みの冒険者では歯が立たないだろう。
jp_grezzo: "希少な鉱石を惜しげもなく使って作られた。長らくゴーレムの最上級種とされていたくらいなので、並みの冒険者では歯が立たないだろう。"
en: It was made using rare ores sparingly. For a long time, it was even considered the most advanced species of golem, so ordinary adventurers would not be able to stand up to it.
en_grezzo: "It was made using rare ores sparingly. For a long time, it was even considered the most advanced species of golem, so ordinary adventurers would not be able to stand up to it."
it: È stato costruito senza risparmiare un minerale rarissimo. Per molto tempo è stato considerato la specie più alta fra i golem, e quindi un avventuriero qualunque non ha niente da fargli.

jp: 紅に輝く炎の殻に包まれた蟹。その身はほっこりと柔らかくとても美味であり、荒んだ心を癒すことができる。火属性であるが、蟹らしく一応水辺でも暮らせるようだ。
jp_grezzo: "紅に輝く炎の殻に包まれた蟹。その身はほっこりと柔らかくとても美味であり、荒んだ心を癒すことができる。火属性であるが、蟹らしく一応水辺でも暮らせるようだ。"
en: The crab is encased in a red, glowing flame shell. Its meat is tender and tasty, and can heal a troubled heart. Although it is fire-based, it can also live near water, just like a crab.
en_grezzo: "The crab is encased in a red, glowing flame shell. Its meat is tender and tasty, and can heal a troubled heart. Although it is fire-based, it can also live near water, just like a crab."
it: Un granchio chiuso in un guscio di fiamma che brilla di rosso. La sua polpa è tenera e molto saporita, e sa consolare un cuore inasprito. È di attributo fuoco, ma da buon granchio pare che riesca a vivere anche in riva all'acqua.

jp: 目の醒めるような赤い体が特徴的。唾液は可燃性で、噛みついた際の摩擦熱で空気と反応して即座に燃焼する。極めて稀だが、よだれで山火事が起きたケースが存在する。
jp_grezzo: "目の醒めるような赤い体が特徴的。唾液は可燃性で、噛みついた際の摩擦熱で空気と反応して即座に燃焼する。極めて稀だが、よだれで山火事が起きたケースが存在する。"
en: It is characterised by its eye-watering red body. Their saliva is flammable and reacts with the air through the frictional heat of their bite, causing it to burn instantly. Although extremely rare, there have been cases of wildfires started by drool.
en_grezzo: "It is characterised by its eye-watering red body. Their saliva is flammable and reacts with the air through the frictional heat of their bite, causing it to burn instantly. Although extremely rare, there have been cases of wildfires started by drool."
it: Si riconosce per il corpo rosso che sveglia dal sonno. La sua saliva è infiammabile, e con il calore dell'attrito quando morde reagisce con l'aria e brucia all'istante. È rarissimo, ma ci sono casi di incendi di bosco appiccati da una bava.

jp: 怪しげな儀式で赤色の下級モンスターやゴーレムを召喚して炎を撒き散らす。年に一度、灼熱の塔に巡礼に行くらしい。
jp_grezzo: "怪しげな儀式で赤色の下級モンスターやゴーレムを召喚して炎を撒き散らす。年に一度、灼熱の塔に巡礼に行くらしい。"
en: They summon red, lower-level monsters and golems and spread flames in a dubious ritual. They go on a pilgrimage to the Burning Tower once a year.
en_grezzo: "They summon red, lower-level monsters and golems and spread flames in a dubious ritual. They go on a pilgrimage to the Burning Tower once a year."
it: Con un rituale sospetto evoca mostri di rango basso e golem di colore rosso e sparge fiamme tutto intorno. Pare che una volta all'anno vada in pellegrinaggio alla Torre Rovente.

jp: 死してなお、戦いに明け暮れる戦士の亡骸。完全に風化した、傷だらけの真白い骨が、過ぎた年月を感じさせる。
jp_grezzo: "死してなお、戦いに明け暮れる戦士の亡骸。完全に風化した、傷だらけの真白い骨が、過ぎた年月を感じさせる。"
en: The corpse of a dead warrior, still fighting. The completely weathered, scarred, white bones remind us of the years that have passed.
en_grezzo: "The corpse of a dead warrior, still fighting. The completely weathered, scarred, white bones remind us of the years that have passed."
it: Il corpo di un guerriero che, anche da morto, passa le giornate a combattere. Le ossa bianchissime, sgretolate dal tempo e piene di intacchi, fanno sentire quanti anni siano passati.

jp: ひたすら強者との殺し合いを欲し死ぬまで戦い続けた狂戦士の骸。命尽きた後でさえも戦えることに喜びを感じており、本能のままに殺戮を続ける。
jp_grezzo: "ひたすら強者との殺し合いを欲し死ぬまで戦い続けた狂戦士の骸。命尽きた後でさえも戦えることに喜びを感じており、本能のままに殺戮を続ける。"
en: The wreckage of a mad warrior who wanted nothing more than to kill the strong and continue to fight until death. Even after his life was over, he was happy to fight, and continued to kill on instinct.
en_grezzo: "The wreckage of a mad warrior who wanted nothing more than to kill the strong and continue to fight until death. Even after his life was over, he was happy to fight, and continued to kill on instinct."
it: Lo scheletro di un guerriero folle che non voleva altro che uccidere ed essere ucciso dai forti, e che ha combattuto fino alla morte. Perfino finita la vita prova gioia a potersi battere, e continua a massacrare seguendo l'istinto.

jp: 死と腐敗を支配する、邪教の神を信仰する狂信者。その言葉を聞いた者は、信じるものの違いに大きく混乱させられるだろう。
jp_grezzo: "死と腐敗を支配する、邪教の神を信仰する狂信者。その言葉を聞いた者は、信じるものの違いに大きく混乱させられるだろう。"
en: A fanatic who believes in a pagan god, who rules over death and decay. Those who hear these words will be greatly confused by the difference in what they believe.
en_grezzo: "A fanatic who believes in a pagan god, who rules over death and decay. Those who hear these words will be greatly confused by the difference in what they believe."
it: Un fanatico che venera il dio di una fede empia, il dio che governa la morte e la putrefazione. Chi ascolta quelle parole resterà molto turbato dalla differenza fra ciò in cui crede lui e ciò in cui crede l'altro.

jp: 兵士を象った大きな駒。数で攻めて来ることも多いため油断は禁物。実は前進しか出来ないので、頑張って方向転換している。
jp_grezzo: "兵士を象った大きな駒。数で攻めて来ることも多いため油断は禁物。実は前進しか出来ないので、頑張って方向転換している。"
en: Large pieces in the shape of soldiers. They often attack in numbers, so you can never be too careful. In fact, they can only move forward, so they do their best to change direction.
en_grezzo: "Large pieces in the shape of soldiers. They often attack in numbers, so you can never be too careful. In fact, they can only move forward, so they do their best to change direction."
it: Un grande pezzo che ha la forma di un soldato. Spesso attacca in tanti, e quindi non conviene distrarsi. In verità sa solo andare avanti, e allora fa una gran fatica a cambiare direzione.

jp: 城壁を象った大きな駒。壁として立ち塞がり、他の者への攻撃を引き受ける。キャスリングルールは採用していないようだ。
jp_grezzo: "城壁を象った大きな駒。壁として立ち塞がり、他の者への攻撃を引き受ける。キャスリングルールは採用していないようだ。"
en: A large piece in the shape of a castle wall. It stands as a wall and undertakes attacks on others. Does not appear to adopt castling rules.
en_grezzo: "A large piece in the shape of a castle wall. It stands as a wall and undertakes attacks on others. Does not appear to adopt castling rules."
it: Un grande pezzo che ha la forma di una muraglia. Si pianta come un muro e si prende addosso gli attacchi diretti agli altri. La regola dell'arrocco, a quanto pare, non la adotta.

jp: 僧正を象った大きな駒。魔法の矢や鈍足、テレポートで盤を荒らすトリッキーな駒だが、飛び回るためにあまり融通が利かないうえに脆い。
jp_grezzo: "僧正を象った大きな駒。魔法の矢や鈍足、テレポートで盤を荒らすトリッキーな駒だが、飛び回るためにあまり融通が利かないうえに脆い。"
en: A large piece in the shape of a monk. Tricky pieces that wreak havoc on the board with their magic arrows, bluntness and teleportation, but they are not very flexible and fragile because they fly around.
en_grezzo: "A large piece in the shape of a monk. Tricky pieces that wreak havoc on the board with their magic arrows, bluntness and teleportation, but they are not very flexible and fragile because they fly around."
it: Un grande pezzo che ha la forma di un vescovo. È un pezzo furbo, che sconvolge la scacchiera con la freccia magica, con la lentezza e con il teletrasporto, ma siccome sta sempre a svolazzare non è molto flessibile ed è fragile.

jp: 馬顔の騎士を象った大きな駒。遠距離攻撃を得意としており、投擲武器を活用して離れた場所からもキングの駒を護衛する。事実だが、馬面とか言わないであげてほしい。
jp_grezzo: "馬顔の騎士を象った大きな駒。遠距離攻撃を得意としており、投擲武器を活用して離れた場所からもキングの駒を護衛する。事実だが、馬面とか言わないであげてほしい。"
en: Large pawns in the shape of horse-faced knights. They specialise in long-range attacks and utilise throwing weapons to escort the king's pawns from a distance. Although factual, please don't tell him he's horse-faced.
en_grezzo: "Large pawns in the shape of horse-faced knights. They specialise in long-range attacks and utilise throwing weapons to escort the king's pawns from a distance. Although factual, please don't tell him he's horse-faced."
it: Un grande pezzo che ha la forma di un cavaliere con la faccia da cavallo. È bravo negli attacchi da lontano e, servendosi delle armi da lancio, scorta il pezzo del Re anche stando distante. Sarà pure vero, ma la faccia da cavallo non stategliela a dire.

jp: 王妃を象った大きな駒。高い機動力と２種類の魔法の矢を使いこなす最強の駒。そのためキングは尻に敷かれている。一応言っておくが、別に王国を持っているわけではない。
jp_grezzo: "王妃を象った大きな駒。高い機動力と２種類の魔法の矢を使いこなす最強の駒。そのためキングは尻に敷かれている。一応言っておくが、別に王国を持っているわけではない。"
en: Large piece in the shape of a queen. The most powerful piece, with high mobility and the ability to use two types of magic arrows. For this reason, the King is a pain in the arse. In case you are wondering, he doesn't have a kingdom.
en_grezzo: "Large piece in the shape of a queen. The most powerful piece, with high mobility and the ability to use two types of magic arrows. For this reason, the King is a pain in the arse. In case you are wondering, he doesn't have a kingdom."
it: Un grande pezzo che ha la forma di una regina. È il pezzo più forte, con una grande mobilità e due tipi di freccia magica. Per questo il Re lo tiene sotto il tallone. Sia detto per inciso: un regno vero e proprio non ce l'ha.

jp: 王を象った大きな駒。無尽蔵の兵力を持ち、多数の駒で戦場を制圧する。王の姿をしているが、指揮権は別の存在が持っているようだ。
jp_grezzo: "王を象った大きな駒。無尽蔵の兵力を持ち、多数の駒で戦場を制圧する。王の姿をしているが、指揮権は別の存在が持っているようだ。"
en: Large pawns in the shape of a king. He has an inexhaustible army and controls the battlefield with a large number of pieces. Although it has the appearance of a king, command seems to be held by another entity.
en_grezzo: "Large pawns in the shape of a king. He has an inexhaustible army and controls the battlefield with a large number of pieces. Although it has the appearance of a king, command seems to be held by another entity."
it: Un grande pezzo che ha la forma di un re. Ha truppe inesauribili e domina il campo di battaglia con una gran quantità di pezzi. Ha l'aspetto di un re, ma pare che il comando ce l'abbia qualcun altro.

jp: 戦士としての能力を、戦争に加わることで活用する流浪の武人。信念を以て活動する者もいるが、多くは賃金を得るため、立場を流転させ暮らしている。
jp_grezzo: "戦士としての能力を、戦争に加わることで活用する流浪の武人。信念を以て活動する者もいるが、多くは賃金を得るため、立場を流転させ暮らしている。"
en: Nomadic warriors who utilise their abilities as warriors by taking part in wars. Some operate out of conviction, but many live from one position to another in order to earn wages.
en_grezzo: "Nomadic warriors who utilise their abilities as warriors by taking part in wars. Some operate out of conviction, but many live from one position to another in order to earn wages."
it: Un uomo d'arme errante che mette a frutto le proprie doti di guerriero prendendo parte alle guerre. C'è chi agisce per convinzione, ma i più cambiano bandiera di continuo, e vivono per il salario.

jp: 射手としての腕前を、抗争に加担する事で生活の糧とする武人。戦況次第で逃走し易いため、しぶとく生き延びる者も多い。
jp_grezzo: "射手としての腕前を、抗争に加担する事で生活の糧とする武人。戦況次第で逃走し易いため、しぶとく生き延びる者も多い。"
en: Archers who use their skills as archers to make a living by taking part in conflicts. Many of them survive, as it is easy for them to flee depending on the war situation.
en_grezzo: "Archers who use their skills as archers to make a living by taking part in conflicts. Many of them survive, as it is easy for them to flee depending on the war situation."
it: Un uomo d'arme che si guadagna da vivere mettendo la propria bravura di arciere al servizio delle contese. A seconda di come va la battaglia gli è facile scappare, e per questo in molti sopravvivono a lungo.

jp: 魔術士としての知識を、戦に適用させる事で生計を立てている。戦況に対応するため、術士と戦士両方の能力を用いて戦う傾向がある。
jp_grezzo: "魔術士としての知識を、戦に適用させる事で生計を立てている。戦況に対応するため、術士と戦士両方の能力を用いて戦う傾向がある。"
en: He makes his living by applying his knowledge as a mage to warfare. He tends to fight using both his skills as a sorcerer and a warrior in order to adapt to the war situation.
en_grezzo: "He makes his living by applying his knowledge as a mage to warfare. He tends to fight using both his skills as a sorcerer and a warrior in order to adapt to the war situation."
it: Si guadagna da vivere applicando alla guerra il suo sapere di mago. Per adattarsi a come va la battaglia tende a combattere usando insieme le doti dello stregone e quelle del guerriero.

jp: 行商人を襲い、商品を奪うことを生業としているならず者達の親分。奪った積荷を売り捌く為に持ち歩いており、襲い掛かった冒険者達に、逆に稼ぎを奪われることも。
jp_grezzo: "行商人を襲い、商品を奪うことを生業としているならず者達の親分。奪った積荷を売り捌く為に持ち歩いており、襲い掛かった冒険者達に、逆に稼ぎを奪われることも。"
en: A leader of a gang of ruffians who make their living by attacking peddlers and robbing them of their goods. They carry their stolen cargo around with them to sell it, and sometimes the adventurers who attack them take their earnings.
en_grezzo: "A leader of a gang of ruffians who make their living by attacking peddlers and robbing them of their goods. They carry their stolen cargo around with them to sell it, and sometimes the adventurers who attack them take their earnings."
it: Il capo di una banda di malviventi che campa assalendo i mercanti ambulanti e portando via la merce. Si porta dietro il carico rubato per rivenderlo, e ogni tanto sono gli avventurieri che lo assalgono a portargli via il guadagno.

jp: 盗賊団に金で雇われている、傭兵崩れ。古くからの慣習でセンセイと呼ばれることもあるとか。用心棒という響きにどこか魅力的なものがあるからかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "盗賊団に金で雇われている、傭兵崩れ。古くからの慣習でセンセイと呼ばれることもあるとか。用心棒という響きにどこか魅力的なものがあるからかもしれない。"
en: A mercenary crackpot, employed by a band of thieves for money. They are sometimes called senshi, according to an old custom. This may be because there is something appealing about the sound of 'bouncer'.
en_grezzo: "A mercenary crackpot, employed by a band of thieves for money. They are sometimes called senshi, according to an old custom. This may be because there is something appealing about the sound of 'bouncer'."
it: Un mercenario finito male, assoldato con del denaro da una banda di ladri. Per una vecchia usanza c'è chi lo chiama maestro. Sarà perché la parola guardaspalle ha in sé qualcosa di attraente.

jp: ド近眼のためなるべく接近して発砲しようとするヒットマン。一応その腕は本物で、凄まじい早さで銃を連射してくる強者も中にはいる。
jp_grezzo: "ド近眼のためなるべく接近して発砲しようとするヒットマン。一応その腕は本物で、凄まじい早さで銃を連射してくる強者も中にはいる。"
en: Hitmen who try to get as close as possible to fire due to their short-sightedness. Some of them are very good at it and fire their guns in rapid succession.
en_grezzo: "Hitmen who try to get as close as possible to fire due to their short-sightedness. Some of them are very good at it and fire their guns in rapid succession."
it: Un sicario che, essendo miope da non dirsi, cerca di sparare il più da vicino possibile. Il mestiere però lo sa, e fra loro c'è anche qualcuno che spara raffiche a una velocità spaventosa.

jp: 行商人を襲撃するならずもの集団の術士。火の魔法をうっかり使ってしまい、略奪品を燃やして怒られる事が多い。変な儀式をやっており、肌を白く染めている。
jp_grezzo: "行商人を襲撃するならずもの集団の術士。火の魔法をうっかり使ってしまい、略奪品を燃やして怒られる事が多い。変な儀式をやっており、肌を白く染めている。"
en: A sorcerer in a group of ruffians who raid peddlers. He often gets angry when he inadvertently uses fire magic and burns looted goods. She performs strange rituals and dyes his skin white.
en_grezzo: "A sorcerer in a group of ruffians who raid peddlers. He often gets angry when he inadvertently uses fire magic and burns looted goods. She performs strange rituals and dyes his skin white."
it: Lo stregone di un gruppo di malviventi che assale i mercanti ambulanti. Gli capita spesso di usare per sbaglio la magia del fuoco, di bruciare il bottino e di prendersi una lavata di capo. Fa riti strani, e si tinge la pelle di bianco.

jp: イェルスに所属する兵士。機械の装備が支給されており、銃器などの兵器を重視して戦闘を行う。銃器に頼り過ぎたのか近接戦闘は苦手で、すぐに衛生兵を呼ぶ事になる。
jp_grezzo: "イェルスに所属する兵士。機械の装備が支給されており、銃器などの兵器を重視して戦闘を行う。銃器に頼り過ぎたのか近接戦闘は苦手で、すぐに衛生兵を呼ぶ事になる。"
en: Soldiers belonging to the Yerles Military. They are supplied with mechanical equipment and focus on firearms and other weapons in combat. They are not good at close combat, perhaps because they rely too much on firearms, and soon end up calling in air supports.
en_grezzo: "Soldiers belonging to the Yerles Military. They are supplied with mechanical equipment and focus on firearms and other weapons in combat. They are not good at close combat, perhaps because they rely too much on firearms, and soon end up calling in air supports."
it: Un soldato che appartiene a Yerles. Gli danno in dotazione un equipaggiamento meccanico, e combatte puntando sulle armi da fuoco e simili. Alle armi da fuoco si affida forse troppo, perché nel corpo a corpo se la cava male e finisce subito per chiamare il medico da campo.

jp: イェルスに所属する兵士の中でも、特に銃器の扱いに優れている者達。赤い色をした装備を身にまとっているが、速度が三倍という訳ではない。
jp_grezzo: "イェルスに所属する兵士の中でも、特に銃器の扱いに優れている者達。赤い色をした装備を身にまとっているが、速度が三倍という訳ではない。"
en: Soldiers belonging to the Yerles Military, who are particularly good with firearms. They wear red-coloured equipment, but it does not mean that they are three times faster.
en_grezzo: "Soldiers belonging to the Yerles Military, who are particularly good with firearms. They wear red-coloured equipment, but it does not mean that they are three times faster."
it: Fra i soldati che appartengono a Yerles, quelli particolarmente bravi a maneggiare le armi da fuoco. Portano un equipaggiamento di colore rosso, ma questo non vuol dire che vadano tre volte più veloci.

jp: ジューア解放軍を率いてイェルス兵の進行を阻んでいる。その豪快な笑いは地のオパートスの真似。機械自体は嫌いではなく、イェルス兵から奪い取った銃を使っている。
jp_grezzo: "ジューア解放軍を率いてイェルス兵の進行を阻んでいる。その豪快な笑いは地のオパートスの真似。機械自体は嫌いではなく、イェルス兵から奪い取った銃を使っている。"
en: He leads the Juere Liberation Army blockading the progress of the Yerles soldiers. His bold laugh is an imitation of a local opus. He is not averse to machines per se, and uses the guns he has taken from the Yerles soldiers.
en_grezzo: "He leads the Juere Liberation Army blockading the progress of the Yerles soldiers. His bold laugh is an imitation of a local opus. He is not averse to machines per se, and uses the guns he has taken from the Yerles soldiers."
it: Guida l'esercito di liberazione di Juere e blocca l'avanzata dei soldati di Yerles. Quella sua risata fragorosa è un'imitazione di Opatos della terra. Le macchine in sé non gli dispiacciono, e usa i fucili strappati ai soldati di Yerles.

jp: 自走砲として開発されたのだが低コストを重視しすぎた結果、出力不足で自走砲としての機動力を実現できなかった。それでも実戦配備され固定砲台として使われている。
jp_grezzo: "自走砲として開発されたのだが低コストを重視しすぎた結果、出力不足で自走砲としての機動力を実現できなかった。それでも実戦配備され固定砲台として使われている。"
en: It was developed as a self-propelled artillery gun, but as a result of too much emphasis on low cost, it could not achieve the mobility of a self-propelled artillery gun due to insufficient power output. Nevertheless, it was deployed in actual combat and used as a fixed battery.
en_grezzo: "It was developed as a self-propelled artillery gun, but as a result of too much emphasis on low cost, it could not achieve the mobility of a self-propelled artillery gun due to insufficient power output. Nevertheless, it was deployed in actual combat and used as a fixed battery."
it: Lo avevano progettato come cannone semovente, ma a furia di badare al costo basso la potenza non è bastata, e la mobilità di un semovente non l'ha mai avuta. Lo hanno schierato lo stesso, e lo usano come batteria fissa.

jp: ジューアの一般的な兵士。元が盗賊や悪人の集まりから始まった国であるため、協調性が無く、兵士としての統率された動きは苦手。
jp_grezzo: "ジューアの一般的な兵士。元が盗賊や悪人の集まりから始まった国であるため、協調性が無く、兵士としての統率された動きは苦手。"
en: A common soldier in Juere. As a country that originally started as a group of bandits and bad guys, they are uncoordinated and not good at controlled movements as soldiers.
en_grezzo: "A common soldier in Juere. As a country that originally started as a group of bandits and bad guys, they are uncoordinated and not good at controlled movements as soldiers."
it: Il soldato comune di Juere. Il paese è nato in origine da un'accozzaglia di ladri e malfattori, e quindi non sanno stare insieme: i movimenti ordinati del soldato non sono il loro forte.

jp: 元はアリーナで命を懸けて怪物と闘っていたが、そんな自らの境遇から脱却するために戦場に出てきたジューアの剣闘士。その瞳は悲壮なまでの決意を湛えている。
jp_grezzo: "元はアリーナで命を懸けて怪物と闘っていたが、そんな自らの境遇から脱却するために戦場に出てきたジューアの剣闘士。その瞳は悲壮なまでの決意を湛えている。"
en: A gladiator from Juere who used to fight monsters for his life in the arena, but came to the battlefield to break free from such a situation of his own. His eyes are filled with tragic determination.
en_grezzo: "A gladiator from Juere who used to fight monsters for his life in the arena, but came to the battlefield to break free from such a situation of his own. His eyes are filled with tragic determination."
it: Un gladiatore di Juere che prima si giocava la vita nell'arena contro i mostri e che, per uscire da quella condizione, è sceso sul campo di battaglia. In quegli occhi c'è una determinazione che fa male a guardarla.

jp: かつては吟遊詩人をやっていた時期もあったが、才能が欠片もなくいつも石を投げつけられていた。その恨みを晴らすべく石を投げる側に回った。
jp_grezzo: "かつては吟遊詩人をやっていた時期もあったが、才能が欠片もなくいつも石を投げつけられていた。その恨みを晴らすべく石を投げる側に回った。"
en: He used to be a bard for a time, but he lacked any talent and was always stoned. He turned to stone-throwing man to avenge that grudge.
en_grezzo: "He used to be a bard for a time, but he lacked any talent and was always stoned. He turned to stone-throwing man to avenge that grudge."
it: C'è stato un periodo in cui faceva il menestrello, ma di talento non ne aveva un briciolo e si prendeva sempre delle sassate. Per vendicarsi di quel rancore è passato dalla parte di chi le pietre le tira.

jp: イルヴァで広く飼われている愛玩動物。何故これほどまでに可愛いのかは謎だが、俊敏な捕食者としての顔も併せ持つ。その肉を食した者は強烈な罪悪感に襲われる。
jp_grezzo: "イルヴァで広く飼われている愛玩動物。何故これほどまでに可愛いのかは謎だが、俊敏な捕食者としての顔も併せ持つ。その肉を食した者は強烈な罪悪感に襲われる。"
en: A pet animal widely kept in Irva. Why they are so cute is a mystery, but they are also agile predators. Anyone who eats its flesh is struck with a strong sense of guilt.
en_grezzo: "A pet animal widely kept in Irva. Why they are so cute is a mystery, but they are also agile predators. Anyone who eats its flesh is struck with a strong sense of guilt."
it: L'animale da compagnia più diffuso in Irva. Perché sia così tremendamente carino resta un mistero, ma ha anche l'altra faccia del predatore agile. Chi ne mangia la carne viene assalito da un senso di colpa fortissimo.

jp: 大人しい性格と白く流れるような毛並みで、家飼いに大人気の猫。小柄で大人になっても大きさは子猫とそう変わらないが、これは相当無茶な交雑を繰り返しての品種「改良」の成果である。
jp_grezzo: "大人しい性格と白く流れるような毛並みで、家飼いに大人気の猫。小柄で大人になっても大きさは子猫とそう変わらないが、これは相当無茶な交雑を繰り返しての品種「改良」の成果である。"
en: With its docile character and white, flowing coat, it is a very popular cat among house-owners. They are small in stature, and as adults they are not so different in size from kittens, but this is the result of breed 'improvement' through repeated and quite reckless crossbreeding.
en_grezzo: "With its docile character and white, flowing coat, it is a very popular cat among house-owners. They are small in stature, and as adults they are not so different in size from kittens, but this is the result of breed 'improvement' through repeated and quite reckless crossbreeding."
it: Con il carattere mite e il pelo bianco che scorre come acqua, è un gatto amatissimo da chi lo tiene in casa. È piccolo, e da adulto non è tanto più grande di un gattino, ma questo è il frutto di un miglioramento della razza fatto incrociando e reincrociando in modo davvero sconsiderato.

jp: 非常にやんちゃで好奇心が強く、親猫が目を離すとすぐにどこかへ行ってしまう。ネフィアなどの危険な場所に迷い込んでしまこともしばしば。
jp_grezzo: "非常にやんちゃで好奇心が強く、親猫が目を離すとすぐにどこかへ行ってしまう。ネフィアなどの危険な場所に迷い込んでしまこともしばしば。"
en: They are very mischievous and curious and will go away as soon as the parent cat takes its eyes off them. They often wander into dangerous places such as Nefia.
en_grezzo: "They are very mischievous and curious and will go away as soon as the parent cat takes its eyes off them. They often wander into dangerous places such as Nefia."
it: È di una vivacità e di una curiosità enormi, e appena la gatta lo perde di vista sparisce chissà dove. Spesso finisce per smarrirsi in posti pericolosi come le Nefia.

jp: 猫族の猛獣。古い文献によると、かつては雄にのみたてがみが存在したらしいが、いつから雌にもたてがみが生えるようになったのかは不明である。
jp_grezzo: "猫族の猛獣。古い文献によると、かつては雄にのみたてがみが存在したらしいが、いつから雌にもたてがみが生えるようになったのかは不明である。"
en: A fierce animal of the cat tribe. According to old documents, only males once had manes, but it is not known when females started to grow manes as well.
en_grezzo: "A fierce animal of the cat tribe. According to old documents, only males once had manes, but it is not known when females started to grow manes as well."
it: Una belva del popolo dei gatti. Secondo i testi antichi un tempo la criniera ce l'avevano soltanto i maschi, ma da quando abbia cominciato a crescere anche alle femmine non si sa.

jp: いたずら好きの猫の神。猫嫌いな人間の家を探しては猫で埋め尽くす行為を繰り返している。なお、普通の猫もライオンもケシーにとっては平等に猫なのだ。
jp_grezzo: "いたずら好きの猫の神。猫嫌いな人間の家を探しては猫で埋め尽くす行為を繰り返している。なお、普通の猫もライオンもケシーにとっては平等に猫なのだ。"
en: Mischievous cat god. He repeatedly seeks out the homes of cat-hating humans and fills them with cats. Note that both ordinary cats and lions are equally cats to Cacy.
en_grezzo: "Mischievous cat god. He repeatedly seeks out the homes of cat-hating humans and fills them with cats. Note that both ordinary cats and lions are equally cats to Cacy."
it: Il dio dei gatti, e gli piace fare dispetti. Cerca le case degli uomini che i gatti non li sopportano e le riempie di gatti, e lo rifà di continuo. Da notare che, per Cacy, il gatto comune e il leone sono gatti allo stesso modo.

jp: 燃えるような紅い宝玉を額に持つ猫。奇妙な鳴き声で獲物を惑わす。宝玉の力なのか、視線を媒体とした魔術を使うことができる。
jp_grezzo: "燃えるような紅い宝玉を額に持つ猫。奇妙な鳴き声で獲物を惑わす。宝玉の力なのか、視線を媒体とした魔術を使うことができる。"
en: Cat with a flaming red treasure ball on its forehead. It uses a strange mewing sound to deceive its prey.It is able to use magic using its gaze as a medium, perhaps due to the power of the jewel.
en_grezzo: "Cat with a flaming red treasure ball on its forehead. It uses a strange mewing sound to deceive its prey.It is able to use magic using its gaze as a medium, perhaps due to the power of the jewel."
it: Un gatto che porta in fronte una gemma rossa come il fuoco. Con un miagolio strano confonde la preda. Sarà il potere della gemma, ma sa usare una magia che passa per lo sguardo.

jp: 人の生活圏で暮らす犬。犬と人類の歴史は古く、太古に滅んだ全ての文明において人類と共にいたという研究結果が出ている。狼より尻尾の筋肉が弱いらしい。
jp_grezzo: "人の生活圏で暮らす犬。犬と人類の歴史は古く、太古に滅んだ全ての文明において人類と共にいたという研究結果が出ている。狼より尻尾の筋肉が弱いらしい。"
en: Dogs live in the habitat of humans. Dogs and humans have a long history, and studies have shown that they were with humans in all civilisations that died out in prehistoric times.They are said to have weaker tail muscles than wolves.
en_grezzo: "Dogs live in the habitat of humans. Dogs and humans have a long history, and studies have shown that they were with humans in all civilisations that died out in prehistoric times.They are said to have weaker tail muscles than wolves."
it: Il cane che vive dove vive l'uomo. La storia dei cani e degli uomini è antica, e le ricerche dicono che i cani stavano con gli uomini in tutte le civiltà estinte nei tempi remoti. Pare che abbiano i muscoli della coda più deboli di quelli del lupo.

jp: ポピーは怖いもの知らずでネフィアの奥に進み続ける、愚かな子犬である。しかし己の力を見誤った冒険者もこの子犬と同じなのだ。
jp_grezzo: "ポピーは怖いもの知らずでネフィアの奥に進み続ける、愚かな子犬である。しかし己の力を見誤った冒険者もこの子犬と同じなのだ。"
en: Poppy is a foolish puppy who is not afraid and keeps going deeper into Nefia. Adventurers who misjudge their own strength are just like this puppy.
en_grezzo: "Poppy is a foolish puppy who is not afraid and keeps going deeper into Nefia. Adventurers who misjudge their own strength are just like this puppy."
it: Poppy è un cucciolo sciocco, che non conosce la paura e continua a spingersi in fondo alle Nefia. Però anche l'avventuriero che sbaglia a misurare le proprie forze è uguale a questo cucciolo.
